failure.definition: First recorded uncorrectable memory failure from the released maintenance tickets; TypeB only.

followup.basis: Organizer announcement 2025-01-24 explicitly states tickets cover Jan 1 through May 31 2024 and devices absent from tickets had no failure in that interval. Coverage ends at June 1; June-July are unlabeled and excluded.

description: TypeB precomputed baseline features, 66 inputs from 15-minute and 1-hour historical windows, 7175 device files. Device ID from filename. No TypeA observations or labels mixed in.
